title: WAGR-435 says linking VIP links to sign-ups is deferred to a future discovery; 9/30 decided users create the VIP link inside the VIP sign-up flow

jira.summary: Affiliate Link: Add VIP flag + exclude from CMS feed (VIP)
jira.quote: How VIP links get formally linked to specific sign-ups/players is still open and was explicitly deferred to a future discovery session

transcript_evidence.quote: Kobi Kunasekaran: maybe we give them the ability to create it in this workflow as opposed to going to deals, finding the deal, adding the link, / Joyce Kiddell: If you could make it automatically tagged as VIP as they're creating it. / Kobi Kunasekaran: yes. / Joyce Kiddell: Yeah, that makes sense.

later_or_conflicting_evidence.quote: Emily Vandenberg: I think yeah, you would just like you could tag it. I feel like Owen could easily add the VIP link. Like we could have that when creating a deal creation and then it would just be your default / Kobi Kunasekaran: I guess the exception case is if there is no existing link in the uh in the deal then either raise an error or uh provide a way to create the link from this interface the first time.

what_differs: WAGR-435 (and the VIP epic) treat VIP link-to-sign-up association as out of scope pending discovery. On 9/30 Joyce and Kobi agreed users can create a link inside the VIP sign-up flow; it attaches to the deal and is tagged VIP automatically.
suggested_action: Update WAGR-435 or WAGR-432 with the 9/30 decision (create link in flow, auto VIP tag, attach to deal) and size it.
